data.name: V&V RPG
data.description:
Vice n' Violence is a DnD game of a more sexual level. The game is set in the world of Mundain, the 14th attempt in creating a world of violence, adventures, sordid stories, & tragic tales. In the East is the continent Asm Sakhif, a land fed by the world's largest river from the mountain Mons Pubis forming the River Cities ruled by the Dragonkin. To the South lies the endless miles-high rainforests of the Bone Forest, home of the ritualistic cannibalistic Elves. To the West is the continent of Drochainm, a lush land of pastures and swamps once ruled by Humans who became a nomadic race but now ruled by Orcs & Goblins. The world is ruled by Magnate Lords that control the resources of the world of Mundain through industrialization.

The Goblins were once feral creatures within the West, but after massive exposures to hallucinogenic cave mushrooms the race attained a level of sentience but are still considered to be nuisance, raiding caravans and raping people as part of their basic instincts. Goblin Males are considerably rarer, and stupider than females. They're often found in caves, busy breeding Goblin Females. Goblin Males make up 6% of the Goblin Population, with only 40% of those males being intelligent enough to speak, negotiate, or fight skillfully.

The Dragonkin were the first dominant race throughout every recreation of this world, but due to their cold blood and inefficient, coiled brains, they have to relax for weeks in order to unlock their impressive intelligence, pumping their blood from their muscles to their minds. They must choose between brains or brawn in life. 

The Elves are a beautiful race that live in the Bone Forests, their love for plant life goes as far as to refuse eating vegetation, so most of their diets revolve around eating meat and flesh- especial from other races.

The Humans are a nomadic race that are spread all over Mundain and are the most victimized of the races when it comes to sex or rape. They are meek, despite their variations of build being quite vast.

The Orcs are a brutish race driven by impulses and are a rowdy race. Lone Orcs are able to live in civil societies just fine, but groups of them tend to run a hierarchy of strength and one upmanship. Though they come they come off as a very intimidating race, they are a deemed very tender lovers.

The Dwarves are a surviving race from the 13th World, they come in two variations: the first is the traditional bearded dwarves that live in the Underground, and the second variation are beardless well endowed dwarves that live on the surface of Mundain. Though they are of two different idealisms, Dwarves are powerful in strength and durability.

The Centaurs are a fusion of humanity and the beasts of burden, mainly humanoids with equine, bovine, or even cervine lower bodies. They are often seen as merchants of many raw materials or Sherpas for the other bipedal races. They are quite polite and soft spoken, notably hospitable to all.

The Satyrs are a conception between Dwarves & Centaurs: have the short stature and drunken revelry of the dwarves & the oversized equine genitalia of the Centaurs, this bastard race is rambunctious and mischievous, even more than the Goblins. But satyrs are also natualic charismatic, making them trustworthy to others and skilled negotiators. They are shrewd negotiators, and quite crass. They have intense heat cycles, with the female's getting quite needy.

When the player dies, they might have a chance to be revived by Ninki the Avatar of the Dead or brought back as an Undead depending on the situation.
The player is able to journey through world of Mundain, having an adventure, diving through dungeons, having your own harem, running businesses like a milkmaid bar, taking on quests- or even sexual quests.

Goblin Females are much more intelligent than their male counterparts.

Goblin Males make up for their lack of intelligence with their… hung packages.

Satyr Males are tall, whilst Satyr Females are short-stacks, burly, roughly 4 feet tall, and quite musky and… soft, carrying fat in all the right places.

Satyr’s hair color matches the fur on their hooved legs/hips. Satyr Males have horse cocks, Satyr Females have horse pussies.

Goblin Males are less common that Goblin Females.

Satyr Females lactate often.

Goblin Males cocks range from 7-9 inches in length.
